bias.label: Sharp bounce into the 3,640-3,651 cap; downtrend holds below 3,651

event: Today, Fri 27 Nov: US half-day (stocks close 20:00 SAST), thin trade. Sun 29 Nov: OPEC+ meeting. Mon 30 Nov: month end. Fri 4 Dec: US jobs report (15:30 SAST, UNVERIFIED). Fed decision Wed 9 Dec, 21:00 SAST, with a 25 bp hike widely expected.

bullets.title: Fast Asian rally
bullets.text: Spot gold jumped about 2.8% to 3,636 by about 07:06 SAST, back above 3,600 for the first time since Thursday's failed attempt (Mettis Global; quote time UNVERIFIED).

bullets.title: Softer dollar
bullets.text: The US dollar slipped in a risk-on Asian session, which gave gold room to bounce from its 15-month low (FXStreet via TMGM).

bullets.title: Hike still coming
bullets.text: Markets still price a Fed hike on 9 December, about 99% per Mitrade, after core PCE at 3.3% and Q3 GDP revised to 4.3%, so the bigger pressure on gold has not gone.

bullets.title: Running hot short-term
bullets.text: The 1H RSI was about 68, near overbought, so a pullback toward 3,600 is possible before any further push (FXStreet via TMGM).

bullets.title: Into old resistance
bullets.text: Price is now testing 3,640-3,651, the top of this week's range and the falling trendline since 17 Nov, where the bigger downtrend gets decided.

bullets.title: Thin holiday trade
bullets.text: US markets are open only for a half-day today, so moves can be jumpy and breakouts less reliable.

buy.title: Buy plan: pullback to 3,600-3,606 holds (counter-trend)
look: This is still against the bigger downtrend, so use half size or skip it.
A slow pullback into 3,600-3,606 with long lower wicks, not a fast drop through it.
A higher low on the 15M chart and a close back above 3,615.
The dollar staying soft through the London session.
Take some profit at 3,640 and move the stop to entry only after that.
watch: Chasing the rally now at 3,630-3,640, right under resistance. Wait for the pullback.
A 1H close under 3,583 means the bounce has failed and 3,550 is next. Step aside.
Today's half-day US trade can spike price through stops. Keep size small.
Moving your stop lower when price gets close. That turns a small loss into a big one.

sell.title: Sell plan: rally fails at 3,673-3,690 (with the main trend)
look: Price pushes up into 3,673-3,690 and stalls near Monday's high 3,689.
A clear 15M rejection wick or a bearish close back under 3,665.
A 1H lower high under 3,706 with RSI turning down from overbought.
The dollar or US yields firming again later today.
Take some profit at 3,640 and move the stop to entry only after that.
watch: Selling too early at 3,636-3,651 while the bounce still has momentum. Wait for the test of 3,673-3,690.
A 1H close above 3,710 means the bounce is stronger and 3,738-3,792 is next. Do not fight it.
Fed, tariff or Middle East headlines can move price fast in thin holiday trade.
